Plain PHP; manual testing: http://localhost:8080 (Docker) or http://localhost/ (local). PHP 8.2/Apache, MySQL 8.0; env credentials; containers web/db; ports 8080/3306; live-code volumes.

Classes PascalCase; controllers end Controller; models singular; methods/variables/properties camelCase; constants UPPER_SNAKE_CASE; tables/columns snake_case; views lowercase_with_underscores under views/. Class files must exactly match classes. Use 4 spaces, same-line opening braces, standalone closing braces, spaces after keywords, no trailing whitespace, blank lines between methods, 120-character soft limit. No strict types.

Use `require_once` with `__DIR__` for absolute paths; dependencies at file tops:
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/database.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../models/User.php';

Always validate and sanitize user input; trim text; validate email/length; use type hints when appropriate. Use PDO::FETCH_ASSOC, prepared statements, PDO exceptions with PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, try-catch (catch PDOException when possible), generic model exceptions, validation-error arrays, and never expose raw database errors. Use `lastInsertId()` and `rowCount()`. Always filter/include user_id for isolation. SQL Injection: Always use prepared statements with PDO, never concatenate queries. XSS Prevention: Always escape output with `htmlspecialchars()` when displaying user data. Password Storage: Use `password_hash()` and `password_verify()` (never md5/sha1). CSRF Protection: Not currently implemented, but recommended for production.

Controllers check `$_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD']`, authenticate, validate, use models, redirect success/render failure. Always verify user authentication before processing. Redirects: Always use `header('Location: ...')` followed by `exit;` to prevent code execution. Models encapsulate database operations. Views include layout first, escape output, use controller variables/`??`, semantic HTML, no business logic. Start session in index.php; store user ID/username after login; destroy session on logout; never store passwords in session. Singleton Database; UTF-8; graceful connection errors.

Implement: schema.sql; models/; controllers/; views/; index.php routes; public/css/style.css if needed; test success/error paths. Always use `??` null coalescing operator for optional request parameters. Use `in_array()` to validate enum values before database operations.
